purpose: Declare the Skill-to-Skill invocation graph so that changing one Skill produces a runnable blast-radius check instead of an ad-hoc grep. Checked by `vh.mjs skills validate --repo <root>`. No Skill reads this file at runtime, it is not a router or a lifecycle, and `skills validate` writes nothing into .vibehub/.

entry_kinds.user: A user or host can select this Skill directly; its description carries a user-facing trigger.
entry_kinds.internal: Reached only from another Skill. Its description says so. An internal Skill with no inbound edge is an orphan.
entry_kinds.infrastructure: Ships as a Skill folder so installers carry it, but is never invoked and holds no edges. Only vibehub-core.

edge_kinds.invokes: The caller runs the target as a step of its own workflow. This subgraph must stay acyclic.
edge_kinds.presents: The caller asks vibehub-review to present a lifecycle event the caller owns.
edge_kinds.routes: The caller directs an explicit record request to its owning Skill. Routing does not execute a Ticket.

skills.name: vibehub-core
skills.note: Helper script, schemas, templates. Reached only as ../vibehub-core/... relative paths, never as a $-invocation.

skills.name: vibehub-distill
skills.note: Writes Room shape and alignment stamps. Its description enumerates its callers and states it is not called directly by a user.

skills.name: vibehub-ingest
skills.note: Bulk absorption delegates the Room tree to distill and presents the written tree through review's Room tree surface (references/bulk-absorption.md).

skills.name: vibehub-mod
skills.note: Also a Claude Code plugin that loads from the skills directory. Its mod reads Tickets through ../vibehub-core and writes nothing; progress records route to vibehub-ticket.

skills.name: vibehub-review
skills.note: Presents task records and Room context. Requested task edits use the Ticket Skill.

skills.name: vibehub-ticket
skills.note: Defines, reads, and updates task memory. Development methods belong to the user’s chosen skills.
